blurb: Willamette Valley Power Yoga offers multiple yoga class types, teacher training programs including 200hr and 300hr trainings, workshops, and retreats. They provide both in-studio and livestream memberships with access to live and on-demand classes. Special events and themed classes are also held throughout the year.
